tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Presumed distance-nonincreasing maps between large spheres] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0512, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0513 ↗ prop:chow-iii-i29-small-sphere-monotonicity 1. appi:1.50\group Points at infinity

For sufficiently large $s_0(p)$ and $t\ge s\ge s_0(p)$, there should exist maps \[ \phi _{s,t}:S(p,s)\to S(p,t) \] that are nonincreasing for the rescaled intrinsic metrics, satisfy $\phi _{t,u}\circ \phi _{s,t}=\phi _{s,u}$, and send $\alpha (s)$ to $\alpha (t)$ for each ray $\alpha $ from $p$. This is the source's Presumed Theorem I.50. \end{claim}
